_comment: Mutation testing measures whether the suite actually kills injected faults, not just whether lines run. Scoped to the correctness and security core; the lexer, parser, async evaluator, stdlib, and autocomplete are deliberately deferred to follow-up expansions. The aggregate score across this scope is ~87.7%; `break` is held a couple of points below that and should be ratcheted up (never down) like the coverage floor in vitest.config.ts. Remaining survivors are equivalent mutants (access-guard kind arguments, switch-label swaps and case fall-through, performance fast-paths the slow path already covers) or defensive branches the type system and parser make unreachable.
